name: v262_social_neglect_equity_news
hypothesis: Positive broad equity news sentiment that is not accompanied by crowded social buzz may capture under-attended good news, with low short-window SPY correlation as a risk filter.
field_notes: mean_equity_sentiment_score active_usage=0; snt_value_fast_d1 and scl12_buzz_fast_d1 active_usage=0; avoids payout/book/buyback/value fields.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_equity_sentiment_score, 60), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_value_fast_d1, 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * scl12_buzz_fast_d1, 60), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_30_days_spy, 60), industry) + 0.10 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)

name: v262_labor_society_news_resilience
hypothesis: Constructive labor and society-related news can signal lower stakeholder or regulatory pressure; combining it with low negative social buzz and low idiosyncratic risk may avoid ordinary earnings/value capacity.
field_notes: rp_nip_labor, rp_css_society, rp_ess_society all have local ACTIVE usage 0; social buzz is only a neglect confirmer.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_labor, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_css_society, 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_fast_d1, 60), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_30_days, 60), industry) + 0.10 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)

name: v262_far_option_skew_social_calm
hypothesis: Very long-tenor option skew and put/call volume calm may measure slow insurance-demand normalization; adding social buzz-return relief and novelty avoids pure option-term siblings.
field_notes: implied_volatility_mean_skew_1080, implied_volatility_mean_skew_720, pcr_vol_1080, and pcr_vol_720 have local ACTIVE usage 0.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(implied_volatility_mean_skew_1080 - implied_volatility_mean_skew_720), 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(pcr_vol_1080 - pcr_vol_720), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 60), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_event_novelty_score, 60), industry) + 0.10 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)

name: v262_model_derivative_sentiment_contrast
hypothesis: Contrarian model16 derivative signals may work when combined with improving earnings certainty and broad composite news sentiment, without option, social alltype, or price-location carriers.
field_notes: multi_factor_acceleration_score_derivative and earnings_certainty_rank_derivative have local ACTIVE usage 0; composite sentiment provides an independent news semantic sleeve.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.30 * rank(-1 * multi_factor_acceleration_score_derivative) + 0.25 * rank(earnings_certainty_rank_derivative) + 0.20 * rank(-1 * composite_factor_score_derivative) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_composite_sentiment_score, 60), industry) + 0.10 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)

name: v262_partner_ptg_news_neglect
hypothesis: Positive price-target and partnership news under low social attention may capture under-reacted external validation, distinct from earnings release, dividend, or book/value capacity.
field_notes: rp_ess_ptg, rp_nip_partner, and rp_css_partner have local ACTIVE usage 0; social buzz is used as an attention penalty.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_ess_ptg, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_partner, 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_css_partner, 90), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * scl12_buzz_fast_d1, 60), industry) + 0.10 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
